answer: Equivocation-proof bonds stop fakes claiming twice. Each identity locks 70 credits, files claims on the crystal ledger, each with a key-bound pearl token, at 5/epoch. Auditors replay the ledger per gale window; a rented-claim ring signing two conflicting claims is caught by both signatures; its bond burns. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and cost 5,000/epoch; each conflicting pair burns 70. Honest agents file one claim per window, pay 5, keep the bond.
